g.text: - Scoring: If it goes through the left side,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the player loses. If it goes through the right

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: side, the computer loses. (Whichever side it

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: exits, that player loses, and one mark is

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: added to the opposing side's score).
